```{r}
#| label: bdf-firmnorm-loglevels-strong
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| cache: true
# BDF (2009) G2SLS on log certification intensity, with STRONG-LINK
# recovered networks: only edges with |w_ij| > 0.7 are retained.
# Countries with no surviving links remain in the panel but have Gy = 0
# (isolated in the network sense).
#
# Rationale: a row-stochastic recovered W with weight > 0.7 indicates a
# dominant influence relationship — country i derives most of its peer
# input from j. Restricting to these "strong ties" (Granovetter 1973) tests
# whether the recovered structure carries explanatory power even when only
# the most concentrated influence channels are retained.
#
# Note: under thresholding without row-renormalisation, rowSums < 1 by
# construction; the BDF identification still goes through provided
# |rho| < 1 (Lee 2004 Econometrica), but Gy is no longer a simple peer
# average — it is a weighted sum that reflects influence concentration.
#
# Outcome: y_it = log(1 + n_cert,it / n_firms,i,2017 * 1000)

set.seed(1861)
B <- 999
N <- length(country_labels)

# ---- Apply strong-link threshold (NO row-renormalisation) -----------------
# Keep only |w_ij| > 0.7; isolated countries get Gy = 0 (their entire row is 0).
strong_link_W <- function(W, threshold = 0.7) {
  W2 <- W
  W2[abs(W2) <= threshold] <- 0
  diag(W2) <- 0
  W2
}

W_q_strong <- strong_link_W(W_q, threshold = 0.7)
W_e_strong <- strong_link_W(W_e, threshold = 0.7)
dimnames(W_q_strong) <- dimnames(W_e_strong) <-
  list(country_labels, country_labels)

# Diagnostic: how many strong links survive, how many countries isolated
n_q_links <- sum(W_q_strong > 0)
n_e_links <- sum(W_e_strong > 0)
isolated_q <- sum(rowSums(W_q_strong) == 0)
isolated_e <- sum(rowSums(W_e_strong) == 0)
mean_rsum_q <- mean(rowSums(W_q_strong))
mean_rsum_e <- mean(rowSums(W_e_strong))

cat(sprintf(
  "W_q (strong, |w|>0.7): %d edges, %d isolated countries, mean rowSum=%.3f\n",
  n_q_links, isolated_q, mean_rsum_q
))
cat(sprintf(
  "W_e (strong, |w|>0.7): %d edges, %d isolated countries, mean rowSum=%.3f\n",
  n_e_links, isolated_e, mean_rsum_e
))

# Stop early if too sparse — give user clear signal
if (n_q_links < 5 | n_e_links < 5) {
  warning("Very few strong links survived (<5). Consider lowering threshold.")
}

# ---- Outcome (reuse attach_y_log_norm, firm17 from previous chunks) ------
panel_q <- keep_full(attach_y_log_norm(
  readRDS(file.path(clean_dir, "panel_9001_eu.rds")), f9001
))
panel_e <- keep_full(attach_y_log_norm(
  readRDS(file.path(clean_dir, "panel_14001_eu.rds")), f14001
))

# ---- IMPORTANT: bypass row_normalise inside build_bdf_panel_lag ----------
# The default helper row-normalises W. We need to use the strong-link W
# *as is* (rowSums < 1 reflect concentration of influence). We define a
# version that skips row_normalise but otherwise replicates the helper.
build_bdf_panel_strong <- function(panel, W, x_vars) {
  G <- W # use as-is; do NOT row-normalise
  diag(G) <- 0
  G2 <- G %*% G
  G3 <- G2 %*% G
  d <- panel[order(panel$year, match(panel$country, rownames(G))), ]
  yrs <- sort(unique(d$year))
  d$Gy <- unlist(lapply(yrs, function(t) {
    yt <- d$y[d$year == t]
    as.numeric(G %*% yt)
  }))
  for (v in x_vars) {
    Xt <- matrix(d[[v]], ncol = length(yrs))
    d[[paste0("G_", v)]] <- as.numeric(G %*% Xt)
    d[[paste0("G2_", v)]] <- as.numeric(G2 %*% Xt)
    d[[paste0("G3_", v)]] <- as.numeric(G3 %*% Xt)
  }
  d <- d[order(d$country, d$year), ]
  d <- d |>
    dplyr::group_by(country) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Gy_lag = dplyr::lag(Gy, n = 1, order_by = year),
      dplyr::across(
        dplyr::all_of(c(paste0("G2_", x_vars), paste0("G3_", x_vars))),
        \(z) dplyr::lag(z, n = 1, order_by = year),
        .names = "{.col}_lag"
      )
    ) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    tidyr::drop_na(Gy_lag)
  d
}

# Build BDF panels: strong-link recovered + Combined ABC (still row-normalised)
bdf_q_lag <- build_bdf_panel_strong(panel_q, W_q_strong, x_vars)
bdf_e_lag <- build_bdf_panel_strong(panel_e, W_e_strong, x_vars)
bdf_comb_q_lag <- build_bdf_panel_lag(panel_q, W_combined, x_vars)
bdf_comb_e_lag <- build_bdf_panel_lag(panel_e, W_combined, x_vars)

# Diagnostic on isolated-country observations: their Gy = 0 contributes
# trivially. Report fraction.
cat(sprintf(
  "Quality (strong): %.1f%% of obs have Gy=0 (isolated countries)\n",
  100 * mean(bdf_q_lag$Gy == 0)
))
cat(sprintf(
  "Environment (strong): %.1f%% of obs have Gy=0 (isolated countries)\n",
  100 * mean(bdf_e_lag$Gy == 0)
))

f_nofe <- as.formula(sprintf(
  "y ~ %s + %s | Gy_lag ~ %s + %s",
  rhs, exo, inst2_lag, inst3_lag
))
f_cfe <- as.formula(sprintf(
  "y ~ %s + %s | country | Gy_lag ~ %s + %s",
  rhs, exo, inst2_lag, inst3_lag
))

nofe_q_rec <- extract_nofe(feols(f_nofe, data = bdf_q_lag, cluster = ~country))
nofe_q_abc <- extract_nofe(feols(f_nofe, data = bdf_comb_q_lag, cluster = ~country))
nofe_e_rec <- extract_nofe(feols(f_nofe, data = bdf_e_lag, cluster = ~country))
nofe_e_abc <- extract_nofe(feols(f_nofe, data = bdf_comb_e_lag, cluster = ~country))

cfe_q_rec <- extract_cfe(cluster_boot(bdf_q_lag, f_cfe, "country", B = B))
cfe_q_abc <- extract_cfe(cluster_boot(bdf_comb_q_lag, f_cfe, "country", B = B))
cfe_e_rec <- extract_cfe(cluster_boot(bdf_e_lag, f_cfe, "country", B = B))
cfe_e_abc <- extract_cfe(cluster_boot(bdf_comb_e_lag, f_cfe, "country", B = B))

tab <- rbind(
  c(
    "Quality", "Endogenous (strong, $|w|>0.7$)",
    sprintf("%.3f%s", nofe_q_rec$b, sig_stars(nofe_q_rec$p)),
    sprintf("%.3f%s", cfe_q_rec$b, sig_stars(cfe_q_rec$p))
  ),
  c(
    "", "",
    sprintf("(%.3f)", nofe_q_rec$se), sprintf("(%.3f)", cfe_q_rec$se)
  ),
  c(
    "Quality", "Combined Exogenous",
    sprintf("%.3f%s", nofe_q_abc$b, sig_stars(nofe_q_abc$p)),
    sprintf("%.3f%s", cfe_q_abc$b, sig_stars(cfe_q_abc$p))
  ),
  c(
    "", "",
    sprintf("(%.3f)", nofe_q_abc$se), sprintf("(%.3f)", cfe_q_abc$se)
  ),
  c(
    "Environment", "Endogenous (strong, $|w|>0.7$)",
    sprintf("%.3f%s", nofe_e_rec$b, sig_stars(nofe_e_rec$p)),
    sprintf("%.3f%s", cfe_e_rec$b, sig_stars(cfe_e_rec$p))
  ),
  c(
    "", "",
    sprintf("(%.3f)", nofe_e_rec$se), sprintf("(%.3f)", cfe_e_rec$se)
  ),
  c(
    "Environment", "Combined Exogenous",
    sprintf("%.3f%s", nofe_e_abc$b, sig_stars(nofe_e_abc$p)),
    sprintf("%.3f%s", cfe_e_abc$b, sig_stars(cfe_e_abc$p))
  ),
  c(
    "", "",
    sprintf("(%.3f)", nofe_e_abc$se), sprintf("(%.3f)", cfe_e_abc$se)
  )
)
tab <- as.data.frame(tab, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(tab) <- c(
  "Panel", "Network",
  "$\\hat\\beta$ (no FE)",
  "$\\hat\\beta$ (country FE)"
)

kbl(tab,
  booktabs = TRUE, format = "latex", escape = FALSE,
  align = "llrr", row.names = FALSE,
  caption = "Endogenous peer effect on log certification intensity, recovered networks restricted to strong ties ($|w_{ij}| > 0.7$). Isolated countries retained in the panel with $Gy_{it} = 0$. Combined Exogenous network row-normalised as before.",
  label = "tab:bdf_firmnorm_loglevels_strong"
) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position", font_size = 10)
```

```{r}
#| label: bdf-strong-logdiff
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| cache: true
# BDF (2009) G2SLS on log-differences with STRONG-LINK recovered networks.
# Outcome: y_it = log(1 + n_cert,it) - log(1 + n_cert,i,t-1)
# Network: only edges with |w_ij| > 0.7 retained, NO row-renormalisation.
# Isolated countries kept in panel with Gy = 0.
# Combined ABC remains row-normalised as before.
#
# Specs:
#   (i)  no FE, asymptotic country-clustered SE
#   (ii) country FE, pairs cluster bootstrap on country (B = 999)

set.seed(1861)
B <- 999
N <- length(country_labels)

# ---- Strong-link extractor (no row-renormalisation) -----------------------
strong_link_W <- function(W, threshold = 0.7) {
  W2 <- W
  W2[abs(W2) <= threshold] <- 0
  diag(W2) <- 0
  W2
}

W_q_strong <- strong_link_W(W_q, threshold = 0.7)
W_e_strong <- strong_link_W(W_e, threshold = 0.7)
dimnames(W_q_strong) <- dimnames(W_e_strong) <-
  list(country_labels, country_labels)

cat(sprintf(
  "W_q (strong, |w|>0.7): %d edges, %d isolated, mean rowSum=%.3f\n",
  sum(W_q_strong > 0), sum(rowSums(W_q_strong) == 0),
  mean(rowSums(W_q_strong))
))
cat(sprintf(
  "W_e (strong, |w|>0.7): %d edges, %d isolated, mean rowSum=%.3f\n",
  sum(W_e_strong > 0), sum(rowSums(W_e_strong) == 0),
  mean(rowSums(W_e_strong))
))

# ---- Outcome builder: log-difference --------------------------------------
attach_y_diff <- function(dp_raw, certs) {
  dp_raw |>
    dplyr::mutate(country = id_to_country[as.character(id)], year = time) |>
    dplyr::select(country, year, x1, x2, x3, x4, x5) |>
    dplyr::inner_join(
      certs |>
        dplyr::filter(country %in% country_labels) |>
        dplyr::arrange(country, year) |>
        dplyr::group_by(country) |>
        dplyr::mutate(
          y = log1p(n_cert) -
            log1p(dplyr::lag(n_cert, n = 1, order_by = year))
        ) |>
        dplyr::ungroup() |>
        dplyr::transmute(country, year, y),
      by = c("country", "year")
    ) |>
    tidyr::drop_na() |>
    dplyr::filter(country %in% country_labels)
}

panel_q <- keep_full(attach_y_diff(
  readRDS(file.path(clean_dir, "panel_9001_eu.rds")), f9001
))
panel_e <- keep_full(attach_y_diff(
  readRDS(file.path(clean_dir, "panel_14001_eu.rds")), f14001
))

cat(sprintf(
  "Quality (log-diff): mean=%.3f, sd=%.3f, range=[%.2f, %.2f]\n",
  mean(panel_q$y), sd(panel_q$y), min(panel_q$y), max(panel_q$y)
))
cat(sprintf(
  "Environment (log-diff): mean=%.3f, sd=%.3f, range=[%.2f, %.2f]\n",
  mean(panel_e$y), sd(panel_e$y), min(panel_e$y), max(panel_e$y)
))

# ---- BDF panel builder for strong-link W (no row-renormalisation) --------
build_bdf_panel_strong <- function(panel, W, x_vars) {
  G <- W
  diag(G) <- 0
  G2 <- G %*% G
  G3 <- G2 %*% G
  d <- panel[order(panel$year, match(panel$country, rownames(G))), ]
  yrs <- sort(unique(d$year))
  d$Gy <- unlist(lapply(yrs, function(t) {
    yt <- d$y[d$year == t]
    as.numeric(G %*% yt)
  }))
  for (v in x_vars) {
    Xt <- matrix(d[[v]], ncol = length(yrs))
    d[[paste0("G_", v)]] <- as.numeric(G %*% Xt)
    d[[paste0("G2_", v)]] <- as.numeric(G2 %*% Xt)
    d[[paste0("G3_", v)]] <- as.numeric(G3 %*% Xt)
  }
  d <- d[order(d$country, d$year), ]
  d <- d |>
    dplyr::group_by(country) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Gy_lag = dplyr::lag(Gy, n = 1, order_by = year),
      dplyr::across(
        dplyr::all_of(c(paste0("G2_", x_vars), paste0("G3_", x_vars))),
        \(z) dplyr::lag(z, n = 1, order_by = year),
        .names = "{.col}_lag"
      )
    ) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    tidyr::drop_na(Gy_lag)
  d
}

# Combined ABC: keep row-normalised (build_bdf_panel_lag does it)
bdf_q_lag <- build_bdf_panel_strong(panel_q, W_q_strong, x_vars)
bdf_e_lag <- build_bdf_panel_strong(panel_e, W_e_strong, x_vars)
bdf_comb_q_lag <- build_bdf_panel_lag(panel_q, W_combined, x_vars)
bdf_comb_e_lag <- build_bdf_panel_lag(panel_e, W_combined, x_vars)

cat(sprintf(
  "Quality (strong, log-diff): %.1f%% obs have Gy=0\n",
  100 * mean(bdf_q_lag$Gy == 0)
))
cat(sprintf(
  "Environment (strong, log-diff): %.1f%% obs have Gy=0\n",
  100 * mean(bdf_e_lag$Gy == 0)
))

f_nofe <- as.formula(sprintf(
  "y ~ %s + %s | Gy_lag ~ %s + %s",
  rhs, exo, inst2_lag, inst3_lag
))
f_cfe <- as.formula(sprintf(
  "y ~ %s + %s | country | Gy_lag ~ %s + %s",
  rhs, exo, inst2_lag, inst3_lag
))

nofe_q_rec <- extract_nofe(feols(f_nofe, data = bdf_q_lag, cluster = ~country))
nofe_q_abc <- extract_nofe(feols(f_nofe, data = bdf_comb_q_lag, cluster = ~country))
nofe_e_rec <- extract_nofe(feols(f_nofe, data = bdf_e_lag, cluster = ~country))
nofe_e_abc <- extract_nofe(feols(f_nofe, data = bdf_comb_e_lag, cluster = ~country))

cfe_q_rec <- extract_cfe(cluster_boot(bdf_q_lag, f_cfe, "country", B = B))
cfe_q_abc <- extract_cfe(cluster_boot(bdf_comb_q_lag, f_cfe, "country", B = B))
cfe_e_rec <- extract_cfe(cluster_boot(bdf_e_lag, f_cfe, "country", B = B))
cfe_e_abc <- extract_cfe(cluster_boot(bdf_comb_e_lag, f_cfe, "country", B = B))

tab <- rbind(
  c(
    "Quality", "Endogenous (strong, $|w|>0.7$)",
    sprintf("%.3f%s", nofe_q_rec$b, sig_stars(nofe_q_rec$p)),
    sprintf("%.3f%s", cfe_q_rec$b, sig_stars(cfe_q_rec$p))
  ),
  c(
    "", "",
    sprintf("(%.3f)", nofe_q_rec$se), sprintf("(%.3f)", cfe_q_rec$se)
  ),
  c(
    "Quality", "Combined Exogenous",
    sprintf("%.3f%s", nofe_q_abc$b, sig_stars(nofe_q_abc$p)),
    sprintf("%.3f%s", cfe_q_abc$b, sig_stars(cfe_q_abc$p))
  ),
  c(
    "", "",
    sprintf("(%.3f)", nofe_q_abc$se), sprintf("(%.3f)", cfe_q_abc$se)
  ),
  c(
    "Environment", "Endogenous (strong, $|w|>0.7$)",
    sprintf("%.3f%s", nofe_e_rec$b, sig_stars(nofe_e_rec$p)),
    sprintf("%.3f%s", cfe_e_rec$b, sig_stars(cfe_e_rec$p))
  ),
  c(
    "", "",
    sprintf("(%.3f)", nofe_e_rec$se), sprintf("(%.3f)", cfe_e_rec$se)
  ),
  c(
    "Environment", "Combined Exogenous",
    sprintf("%.3f%s", nofe_e_abc$b, sig_stars(nofe_e_abc$p)),
    sprintf("%.3f%s", cfe_e_abc$b, sig_stars(cfe_e_abc$p))
  ),
  c(
    "", "",
    sprintf("(%.3f)", nofe_e_abc$se), sprintf("(%.3f)", cfe_e_abc$se)
  )
)
tab <- as.data.frame(tab, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(tab) <- c(
  "Panel", "Network",
  "$\\hat\\beta$ (no FE)",
  "$\\hat\\beta$ (country FE)"
)

kbl(tab,
  booktabs = TRUE, format = "latex", escape = FALSE,
  align = "llrr", row.names = FALSE,
  caption = "Endogenous peer effect on log-differences, recovered networks restricted to strong ties ($|w_{ij}| > 0.7$). Isolated countries retained with $Gy_{it} = 0$.",
  label = "tab:bdf_strong_logdiff"
) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position", font_size = 10)
```
